title_zh: 尝试汤中香草替换的细微差别

scenario.goal_zh: 比较两份样汤的香草差别并决定在食谱旁记录替换选择

context_zh: 家庭烹饪爱好者 Cam 与 Eri 面前已有两小份试做汤，一份用欧芹，一份用罗勒。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Cam
sentences.text: Could we substitute basil for parsley in the final recipe?

sentences.speaker: Eri
sentences.text: Try these two samples. The substitution changes the aroma, but I want to know which you prefer.

sentences.speaker: Cam
sentences.text: Shall I stir this one before tasting it? The herbs are floating on top.

sentences.speaker: Eri
sentences.text: Yes. That bowl has the basil; the other has parsley.

sentences.speaker: Cam
sentences.text: The difference is subtle, but I prefer the basil sample.

sentences.speaker: Eri
sentences.text: So do I. Let’s note the choice beside the recipe rather than pretend we followed it exactly.

sentences.speaker: Cam
sentences.text: I’ll write “basil instead of parsley” in our test notes.

targets.sense_zh: 用一种配料替换另一种
